name: Seoul Ashtanga Vidya
reason: Too thin and nothing dated since 2024: its own site (ashtangavidya.com; robots.txt allows us) has a daily Mysore programme in Seoul run by Greg Steward and Yujung Choi (both authorised), a contact form and a pricing post dated September 2021 (from ₩230,000 a month); its only other posts are quotations from 2016-2017, and there are no workshops, trainings or other offerings. Not enough to show current activity under the brief.
